flags: More than 90% of graph nodes lie in the largest component; this is not evidence of campaign separation.
Modality-availability controls and stratified composition must accompany pooled fusion metrics.
Some rules have zero observed false positives. A zero-width bootstrap interval does not establish zero population risk; IID binomial reference limits are supplied separately.
Parent-dataset subset selection not supplied; input file retained without resampling.

limits.data: Generated surveillance descriptors and an existing cyber subset; no independent physical-cyber test dataset.
limits.history: The dataset has previously been inspected; within-run test separation is not a new prospective external validation.
limits.uncertainty: Deterministic posterior-distance ambiguity, not epistemic uncertainty.
limits.alignment: Synthetic cyber timing and label-blind paired diagnostics, not observed correspondence.
limits.fusion_target: OR and AND of branch labels, not independent incident or campaign annotations.
limits.fusion_probability: Adjusted scores and discounted masses are not asserted to be calibrated OR-event probabilities.
limits.baselines: Dempster-Shafer algebra uses an explicitly defined score-to-mass mapping; no DDEF neural architecture is implemented.
limits.graph: Same-modality score similarity and surrogate time do not prove campaign identity or causal linkage.
limits.statistics: Conditional percentile intervals depend on cluster/block assumptions; repeated seeds and holdouts are descriptive sensitivity analyses.
limits.human_evaluation: No human participants, cognitive-workload evaluation, trust evaluation, or feedback learning.
